title.zh: 卷五十七 志第十 天文十
title.raw: 卷五十七 志第十 天文十 Volume 57 Treatises 10: Astronomy 10

sentences.zh: 流隕一

translations.literal: Flowing Meteors I
translations.idiomatic: Meteor Showers I

sentences.zh: 建隆元年正月戊午，有星出東北方，青赤色，北行，初小後大，尾跡斷續，光燭地。

translations.literal: Jianlong 1, first month, day wuwu: a star rose in the northeast, blue-red in color, traveling north; at first small, then large; its tail-track intermittent; its light lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianlong 1, first month, on wuwu, a star rose in the northeast, blue-red in color, and traveled north; at first small, then growing larger, with an intermittent tail-track whose light lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 四月，有星出天市垣。

translations.literal: Fourth month: a star rose from the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, a star rose from the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，有大星赤色，出心大星。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: a large red star rose from the Heart's great star.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou, a large red star rose from the Heart's great star.

sentences.zh: 甲申，有星赤色，出太微垣，曆上相。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: a red star rose from the Supreme Palace Enclosure, passing the Upper Prime Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, a red star rose from the Supreme Palace Enclosure and passed the Upper Prime Minister star.

sentences.zh: 乙未，有大星色赤，流虛東北。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: a large red star streamed toward the northeast of Emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, a large red star streamed toward the northeast of Emptiness.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，有星出昴。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: a star rose from the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guihai, a star rose from the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 甲子，有星如缶，出卯，光明燭地。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: a star like a jar rose from Mao; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, a jar-sized star rose from Mao, and its brilliance lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，有星青赤色，出參旗西南，慢行而沒，蒼光燭地。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuchen: a blue-red star rose southwest of the Three Stars Banner, moved slowly and vanished; blue light lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, a blue-red star rose southwest of the Three Stars Banner, moved slowly and vanished, its blue light lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 三年六月丁酉，有星出天市，入南斗魁。

translations.literal: Third year, sixth month, day dingyou: a star rose from the Celestial Market and entered the Southern Dipper's bowl.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, sixth month, on dingyou, a star rose from the Celestial Market and entered the Southern Dipper's bowl.

sentences.zh: 乾德元年二月丙午，有星如桃，色赤，出弧矢東南沒，有光明。

translations.literal: Qiande 1, second month, day bingwu: a star like a peach, red in color, rose from the Bow and Arrow and vanished in the southeast; there was brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 1, second month, on bingwu, a peach-sized red star rose from the Bow and Arrow and vanished in the southeast, shining brightly.

sentences.zh: 二年二月乙丑，有星黃白色，出太微五帝南，速行至外廚沒，其體散落，光燭地。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, day yichou: a yellow-white star rose south of the Five Emperors of the Supreme Palace, moved rapidly to the Outer Kitchen and vanished; its body scattered; its light lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, second month, on yichou, a yellow-white star rose south of the Five Emperors of the Supreme Palace, streaked rapidly to the Outer Kitchen and vanished, its body scattering as its light lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 三年六月丁巳，有星如桃，色黃赤，出北斗魁，經太微垣北，過角宿西，漸大，行五尺餘，沒，尾跡凝天有光明。

translations.literal: Third year, sixth month, day dingsi: a star like a peach, yellow-red in color, rose from the Northern Dipper's bowl, passed north of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, crossed west of the Horn lodge, gradually grew larger, traveled more than five chi, and vanished; its tail-track lingered in the sky with brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, sixth month, on dingsi, a peach-sized yellow-red star rose from the Northern Dipper's bowl, passed north of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and west of the Horn constellation, gradually growing larger as it traveled more than five chi and vanished, its tail-track lingering brilliantly in the sky.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，有星出天河，青白色，南行至天倉沒，初小後大，光濁地。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi: a star rose from the Celestial River, blue-white in color, traveled south to the Celestial Storehouse and vanished; at first small, then large; its light dimmed the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, a blue-white star rose from the Celestial River, traveled south to the Celestial Storehouse and vanished; at first small, then growing larger, its murky light spread over the ground.

sentences.zh: 四年正月乙未，有星出天社，青白色，速行，尾跡三丈餘，初小後大，沒，有光明。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, day yiwei: a star rose from the Celestial Altars, blue-white in color, moved rapidly; its tail-track more than three zhang; at first small, then large; it vanished; there was brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month, on yiwei, a blue-white star rose from the Celestial Altars and moved rapidly, leaving a tail-track more than three zhang long; at first small, then larger, it vanished in a blaze of light.

sentences.zh: 四月甲寅，有星出天乳，青赤色，東南行，貫房沒，光燭地。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiayin: a star rose from the Celestial Milk, blue-red in color, traveled southeast, pierced through the Room and vanished; its light lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiayin, a blue-red star rose from the Celestial Milk, traveled southeast, pierced through the Room constellation and vanished, its light lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 閏八月己丑，有星出天船，青白色，西北速行，沒于文昌。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day jichou: a star rose from the Celestial Ship, blue-white in color, moved rapidly northwest, and vanished at Wenchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month, on jichou, a blue-white star rose from the Celestial Ship, streaked rapidly northwest, and vanished at Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 開寶元年七月戊子，有星出大角，青白色，北行沒，明燭地。

translations.literal: Kaibao 1, seventh month, day wuzi: a star rose from the Great Horn, blue-white in color, traveled north and vanished; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao 1, seventh month, on wuzi, a blue-white star rose from the Great Horn, traveled north and vanished, its brilliance lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，有星出文昌，赤黃色，東北速行而沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: a star rose from Wenchang, red-yellow in color, moved rapidly northeast and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi, a red-yellow star rose from Wenchang, streaked rapidly northeast and vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年六月己卯，有星出河鼓，慢行，明燭地。

translations.literal: Second year, sixth month, day jimao: a star rose from the Drum at the River, moved slowly; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, sixth month, on jimao, a star rose from the Drum at the River, moved slowly, and its brilliance lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 三年九月庚午，廣州民見衆星皆北流。

translations.literal: Third year, ninth month, day gengwu: the people of Guangzhou saw many stars all streaming north.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, ninth month, on gengwu, the people of Guangzhou saw many stars all streaming northward.

sentences.zh: 四年八月辛卯，有星出織女，西北行，尾跡三丈餘，沒，久有聲。

translations.literal: Fourth year, eighth month, day xinmao: a star rose from the Weaving Maid, traveled northwest; its tail-track more than three zhang; it vanished; after a long while there was a sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, eighth month, on xinmao, a star rose from the Weaving Maid and traveled northwest, leaving a tail-track more than three zhang long; after it vanished, a sound was heard long afterward.

sentences.zh: 五年八月乙巳，有星出王良，西北行，四丈餘，有聲而散。

translations.literal: Fifth year, eighth month, day yisi: a star rose from Wang Liang, traveled northwest for more than four zhang; there was a sound and it scattered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, eighth month, on yisi, a star rose from Wang Liang and traveled northwest for more than four zhang, then scattered with a sound.

sentences.zh: 七年九月甲午，有星出室，西北行，星體散落有聲，明燭地。

translations.literal: Seventh year, ninth month, day jiawu: a star rose from Encampment, traveled northwest; its body scattered with a sound; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, ninth month, on jiawu, a star rose from Encampment and traveled northwest, its body scattering with a sound as its brilliance lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年十月甲寅，有星出天船，赤黃色，至天棓，星體散落，明燭地。

translations.literal: Taiping Xingguo 3, tenth month, day jiayin: a star rose from the Celestial Ship, red-yellow in color, reached the Celestial Club; its body scattered; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 3, tenth month, on jiayin, a red-yellow star rose from the Celestial Ship and reached the Celestial Club, its body scattering as its brilliance lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 八年三月丙寅，有星晝出西南，當未地，青白色，尾跡二丈余，沒于東南，有光明。

translations.literal: Eighth year, third month, day bingyin: a star appeared by day in the southwest, in the Wei quarter; blue-white in color; its tail-track more than two zhang; it vanished in the southeast; there was brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, third month, on bingyin, a star appeared by day in the southwest, in the Wei quarter, blue-white in color, with a tail-track more than two zhang long; it vanished in the southeast, shining brightly.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，有星如稱權，沒于婁。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinsi: a star like a steelyard weight vanished at the Bond.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinsi, a steelyard-weight-sized star vanished at the Bond constellation.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，有星出紫微鉤陳東，赤黃色，向北速行，近北極沒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin: a star rose east of the Purple Forbidden Hooked Array, red-yellow in color, moved rapidly north, and vanished near the North Pole.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin, a red-yellow star rose east of the Purple Forbidden Hooked Array, streaked rapidly north, and vanished near the North Pole.

sentences.zh: 雍熙元年十月丁酉，有星出昴，赤色，東南蛇行二丈餘，沒。

translations.literal: Yongxi 1, tenth month, day dingyou: a star rose from the Hairy Head, red in color, serpentined southeast for more than two zhang, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 1, tenth month, on dingyou, a red star rose from the Hairy Head, serpentined southeast for more than two zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年正月壬戌，有星出東井，其大倍于金星，入輿鬼沒。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day renxu: a star rose from the Eastern Well, twice as large as Venus, entered the Celestial Coach and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month, on renxu, a star rose from the Eastern Well, twice the size of Venus, entered the Celestial Coach and vanished.

sentences.zh: 四年六月庚戌酉初，有星出西北，色青白，入濁，當戌地，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Fourth year, sixth month, day gengxu, at the start of you: a star rose in the northwest, blue-white in color, entered the Murky, in the Xu quarter; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, sixth month, on gengxu at the start of the you watch, a blue-white star rose in the northwest, entered the Murky in the Xu quarter, with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，有星出天關東，色赤黃，尾貫月。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai: a star rose east of the Celestial Gate, red-yellow in color; its tail pierced the moon.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yihai, a red-yellow star rose east of the Celestial Gate, its tail piercing the moon.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年九月辛巳，有星出羽林，色青，南行，光奪月。

translations.literal: Chunhua 1, ninth month, day xinsi: a star rose from the Feathered Forest, blue in color, traveled south; its light outshone the moon.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 1, ninth month, on xinsi, a blue star rose from the Feathered Forest, traveled south, and its light outshone the moon.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，流星出天關，南行，曆天井、郎位、攝提，至大角東北墜於地，光芒四照，聲如隤牆。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu: a meteor rose from the Celestial Gate, traveled south, passed the Celestial Well, Official of Honor, and Leading the Hunt, and fell to earth northeast of the Great Horn; its radiance shone in all directions; its sound was like a collapsing wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu, a meteor rose from the Celestial Gate and traveled south, passing the Celestial Well, Official of Honor, and Leading the Hunt, then fell to earth northeast of the Great Horn; its radiance shone in all directions, and its sound was like a collapsing wall.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丙申，有星出水府西，色赤黃，經參旗分爲三星，相從至天苑東沒，光燭地。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day bingshen: a star rose west of the Water Office, red-yellow in color, passed the Three Stars Banner and split into three stars, following one another to the east of the Celestial Park and vanishing; its light lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month, on bingshen, a red-yellow star rose west of the Water Office, passed the Three Stars Banner and split into three stars that followed one another to the east of the Celestial Park and vanished, their light lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉，有星出雲雨側，色青白，緩行三尺餘，沒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guiyou: a star rose beside Clouds and Rain, blue-white in color, moved slowly for more than three chi, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guiyou, a blue-white star rose beside Clouds and Rain, moved slowly for more than three chi, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年三月己酉未時，西北方有星西北速行，色青白，有尾跡。

translations.literal: Second year, third month, day jiyou, at the wei hour: in the northwest a star moved rapidly northwest, blue-white in color, with a tail-track.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, third month, on jiyou at the wei hour, a blue-white star in the northwest streaked rapidly northwest, leaving a tail-track.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯，有星出文昌，西南速行至柳，分爲二星而沒。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jimao: a star rose from Wenchang, moved rapidly southwest to the Willow, split into two stars, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jimao, a star rose from Wenchang, streaked southwest to the Willow, split into two stars, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，有星出天市垣屠肆東，色青白，西北慢行丈余，分爲三星，從而沒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou: a star rose east of the Butcher's Shop in the Celestial Market Enclosure, blue-white in color, moved slowly northwest for more than a zhang, split into three stars, and vanished following one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jichou, a blue-white star rose east of the Butcher's Shop in the Celestial Market Enclosure, moved slowly northwest for more than a zhang, split into three stars, and vanished in succession.

sentences.zh: 四年五月乙未平明，有星東南出南斗，色青白，西北行而沒。

translations.literal: Fourth year, fifth month, day yiwei, at daybreak: a star rose in the southeast from the Southern Dipper, blue-white in color, traveled northwest and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, fifth month, on yiwei at daybreak, a blue-white star rose in the southeast from the Southern Dipper, traveled northwest and vanished.

sentences.zh: 五年八月己酉，常星未見，有星出東方，色青白，東北慢行，至濁沒，大約出奎、婁間。

translations.literal: Fifth year, eighth month, day jiyou: the fixed stars were not visible; a star rose in the east, blue-white in color, moved slowly northeast to the Murky and vanished, roughly rising between the Stride and the Bond.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, eighth month, on jiyou, when the fixed stars were not visible, a blue-white star rose in the east, moved slowly northeast to the Murky and vanished, roughly between the Stride and the Bond.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，有星出昴北，緩行，過捲舌，至礪石沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu: a star rose north of the Hairy Head, moved slowly, passed Rolled Tongue, and vanished at Whetstone.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu, a star rose north of the Hairy Head, moved slowly, passed Rolled Tongue, and vanished at Whetstone.

sentences.zh: 至道元年四月乙巳，常星未見，有星出心北，色青赤，急行而墜。

translations.literal: Zhidao 1, fourth month, day yisi: the fixed stars were not visible; a star rose north of the Heart, blue-red in color, moved rapidly and fell.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao 1, fourth month, on yisi, when the fixed stars were not visible, a blue-red star rose north of the Heart, streaked rapidly and fell.

sentences.zh: 七月癸丑，有星出危，色青白，入羽林沒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guichou: a star rose from Rooftop, blue-white in color, entered the Feathered Forest and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guichou, a blue-white star rose from Rooftop, entered the Feathered Forest and vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年五月辛丑，有星出紫微北，尾跡丈餘，如彗而有聲，墜於壁、室間。

translations.literal: Second year, fifth month, day xinchou: a star rose north of the Purple Forbidden, with a tail-track more than a zhang, like a comet and with a sound; it fell between the Wall and Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, fifth month, on xinchou, a star rose north of the Purple Forbidden with a tail-track more than a zhang, comet-like and with a sound, falling between the Wall and Encampment.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，日未及地五尺間，有星出中天，色赤黃，有尾跡，東行速行二丈餘，沒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei: when the sun was still five chi above the horizon, a star rose at mid-heaven, red-yellow in color, with a tail-track; it moved rapidly east for more than two zhang and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiwei, when the sun was still five chi above the horizon, a red-yellow star rose at mid-heaven with a tail-track, streaked east for more than two zhang, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，有星出牽牛西，曆狗國，光芒丈余，墜東南，及地無聲。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jimao: a star rose west of the Ox Leader, passed the Dog Country, with a radiance more than a zhang; it fell in the southeast; reaching the ground there was no sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, a star rose west of the Ox Leader, passed the Dog Country with a radiance more than a zhang, and fell in the southeast; it reached the ground without a sound.

sentences.zh: 又有星出翼，貫天廟，墜於稷星東，光燭地。

translations.literal: Again a star rose from Wings, pierced the Celestial Temple, and fell east of the Millet Star; its light lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Again a star rose from Wings, pierced the Celestial Temple, and fell east of the Millet Star, its light lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉平明，有星出北方，東行三丈余，分爲三星，從而沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou, at daybreak: a star rose in the north, traveled east for more than three zhang, split into three stars, and vanished following one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou at daybreak, a star rose in the north, traveled east for more than three zhang, split into three stars, and vanished in succession.

sentences.zh: 三年九月丁丑，有星二，隕於西南，一出南斗，一出牽牛，有光三丈許。

translations.literal: Third year, ninth month, day dingchou: two stars fell in the southwest; one rose from the Southern Dipper, one from the Ox Leader; their light about three zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, ninth month, on dingchou, two stars fell in the southwest—one from the Southern Dipper, one from the Ox Leader—with light about three zhang long.

sentences.zh: 咸平五年三月丙午，有星晝出心，至南斗沒，赤光丈餘。

translations.literal: Xianping 5, third month, day bingwu: a star appeared by day from the Heart, reached the Southern Dipper and vanished; red light more than a zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 5, third month, on bingwu, a star appeared by day from the Heart, reached the Southern Dipper and vanished, with red light more than a zhang long.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，有星出營室，色白。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinsi: a star rose from Encampment, white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, a white star rose from Encampment.

sentences.zh: 丙申，有流星出東方，西南行，大如鬥，有聲若牛吼，小星數十隨之而隕。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: a meteor rose in the east, traveled southwest, as large as a dipper; its sound was like an ox's roar; several dozen small stars followed it and fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, a dipper-sized meteor rose in the east and traveled southwest with a sound like an ox's roar, and several dozen small stars followed it and fell.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，又有星十數入輿鬼，至中台，凡一大星偕小星數十隨之，其間兩星，一至狼星，一至南斗沒。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: again more than ten stars entered the Celestial Coach, reaching the Central Terrace; in all one large star with several dozen small stars following; among them two stars, one reaching the Wolf Star, one reaching the Southern Dipper and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, again more than ten stars entered the Celestial Coach and reached the Central Terrace; one large star with several dozen small stars following, among which two stars went separately—one to the Wolf Star, one to the Southern Dipper and vanished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，有星晝出紫微垣，貫北斗沒。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: a star appeared by day from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, pierced the Northern Dipper and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, a star appeared by day from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, pierced the Northern Dipper and vanished.

sentences.zh: 壬子，有星出中天，尾跡數道如迸火，西流至狼、弧沒。

translations.literal: Day renzi: a star rose at mid-heaven; its tail-track in several tracks like bursting fire; it streamed west to the Wolf and the Bow and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, a star rose at mid-heaven with several tail-tracks like bursting fire, streamed west to the Wolf and the Bow and vanished.

sentences.zh: 六年五月乙未，有星出王良西，又出北極稍東北，至垣外沒，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Sixth year, fifth month, day yiwei: a star rose west of Wang Liang, again rose slightly northeast of the North Pole, reached outside the enclosure and vanished; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, fifth month, on yiwei, a star rose west of Wang Liang, then rose again slightly northeast of the North Pole, reached outside the enclosure and vanished with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，有星晝出東北方，色黃白，有尾跡。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengwu: a star appeared by day in the northeast, yellow-white in color, with a tail-track.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengwu, a yellow-white star appeared by day in the northeast, leaving a tail-track.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，有星出昴，尾跡丈余，色白，隱隱有聲，至狼星沒。

sentences.zh: 己亥，星出天津，西南入濁。

translations.literal: Day jihai: a star rose from the Celestial Ford, entered the Murky southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, a star rose from the Celestial Ford and entered the Murky southwest.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，星出土司空，東南入濁。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen: a star rose from the Earth Minister, entered the Murky southeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen, a star rose from the Earth Minister and entered the Murky southeast.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，星出東壁，大如杯，西行，至虛沒，有尾跡，赤黃，明燭地。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: a star rose from the Eastern Wall, as large as a cup, traveled west to Emptiness and vanished; with a tail-track; red-yellow; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, a cup-sized red-yellow star rose from the Eastern Wall with a tail-track, traveled west to Emptiness and vanished, its brilliance lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 十月丙子，星出昴，如太白，西北速行，至天大將軍沒，尾跡赤黃。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingzi: a star rose from the Hairy Head, like Great White, moved rapidly northwest to the Great Celestial General and vanished; its tail-track red-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingzi, a Venus-sized star rose from the Hairy Head with a red-yellow tail-track, streaked northwest to the Great Celestial General and vanished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，星出大陵，如太白，南行，至天倉沒。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: a star rose from the Great Mound, like Great White, traveled south to the Celestial Storehouse and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, a Venus-sized star rose from the Great Mound, traveled south to the Celestial Storehouse and vanished.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，星出南河，至天社沒，明燭地。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: a star rose from the Southern River, and vanished at the Celestial Altars; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, a star rose from the Southern River and vanished at the Celestial Altars, its brilliance lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，星出天廟，南入濁。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: a star rose from the Celestial Temple, entered the Murky south.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, a star rose from the Celestial Temple and entered the Murky south.

sentences.zh: 己亥，星出參，如太白，西南行，至天園沒，尾跡青白。

translations.literal: Day jihai: a star rose from the Three Stars, like Great White, traveled southwest to the Celestial Garden and vanished; its tail-track blue-white.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, a Venus-sized star rose from the Three Stars, traveled southwest to the Celestial Garden and vanished with a blue-white tail-track.

sentences.zh: 八年正月辛酉，星出軫，赤黃色，東南速行，入庫樓沒。

translations.literal: Eighth year, first month, day xinyou: a star rose from the Chariot Crossbar, red-yellow, moved rapidly southeast into the Arsenal and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, first month, on xinyou, a red-yellow star rose from the Chariot Crossbar, streaked southeast into the Arsenal and vanished.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，星出匏瓜，東南至危沒，赤黃色，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao: a star rose from the Gourd, traveled southeast to Rooftop and vanished; red-yellow, with a tail-track; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, a red-yellow star rose from the Gourd with a tail-track, traveled southeast to Rooftop and vanished, its brilliance lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，星出文昌，北行入濁，有尾跡，明燭地。

translations.literal: Day guihai: a star rose from Wenchang, traveled north into the Murky; with a tail-track; its brilliance lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, a star rose from Wenchang with a tail-track, traveled north into the Murky, its brilliance lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 又有星出傳舍，速行至北辰沒。

translations.literal: Again a star rose from the Guest House, moved rapidly to the Northern Asterism and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Again a star rose from the Guest House, streaked rapidly to the Northern Asterism and vanished.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，星出天市垣宗人側，東南速行，至鱉星沒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guimao: a star rose beside the Clansman of the Celestial Market Enclosure, moved rapidly southeast to the Turtle Star and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao, a star rose beside the Clansman of the Celestial Market Enclosure, streaked southeast to the Turtle Star and vanished.

sentences.zh: 己亥，星出招搖，赤黃色，行南向，入氐沒。

translations.literal: Day jihai: a star rose from the Twinkling Indicator, red-yellow, traveled southward and vanished at the Base.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, a red-yellow star rose from the Twinkling Indicator, traveled southward and vanished at the Base.

sentences.zh: 七月乙丑，星數百，縱橫西流。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day yichou: several hundred stars streamed west in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yichou, several hundred stars streamed west in all directions.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，星出閣道，東南速行，入濁沒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengyin: a star rose from the Raised Road, moved rapidly southeast into the Murky and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengyin, a star rose from the Raised Road, streaked southeast into the Murky and vanished.

sentences.zh: 甲子，星出上臺，大如杯，赤黃色，向東速行，至下臺沒。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: a star rose from the Upper Terrace, as large as a cup, red-yellow, moved rapidly east to the Lower Terrace and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, a cup-sized red-yellow star rose from the Upper Terrace, streaked east to the Lower Terrace and vanished.

sentences.zh: 治平元年二月丁卯，星出紫宮鉤陳側，西北入濁沒，明燭地，尾跡炸烈有聲。

translations.literal: Zhiping 1, second month, day dingmao: a star rose beside the Purple Palace Hooked Array, entered the Murky northwest and vanished; its brilliance lit the ground; its tail-track exploded with a sound.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiping 1, second month, on dingmao, a star rose beside the Purple Palace Hooked Array, entered the Murky northwest and vanished, its brilliance lighting the ground as its tail-track exploded with a sound.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，夜漏未上，星出河鼓，東南速行，至危沒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou: before the night watch had begun, a star rose from the Drum at the River, moved rapidly southeast to Rooftop and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou, before the night watch had begun, a star rose from the Drum at the River, streaked southeast to Rooftop and vanished.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，星出危，西南速行，入天市垣沒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guiwei: a star rose from Rooftop, moved rapidly southwest into the Celestial Market Enclosure and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guiwei, a star rose from Rooftop, streaked southwest into the Celestial Market Enclosure and vanished.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，星出北辰，大如杯，速行至鉤陳沒，尾跡青黃。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinhai: a star rose from the Northern Asterism, as large as a cup, moved rapidly to the Hooked Array and vanished; its tail-track blue-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai, a cup-sized star rose from the Northern Asterism, streaked rapidly to the Hooked Array and vanished with a blue-yellow tail-track.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，星出奎，大如碗，速行至五車沒。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: a star rose from the Stride, as large as a bowl, moved rapidly to the Five Chariots and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, a bowl-sized star rose from the Stride, streaked rapidly to the Five Chariots and vanished.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，夜漏盡，星出奎，西南行，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Day renxu: when the night watch ended, a star rose from the Stride, traveled southwest to the Murky and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, when the night watch ended, a star rose from the Stride, traveled southwest to the Murky and vanished.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，星出北斗魁，大如盞，東北速行，至濁沒，尾跡赤黃。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: a star rose from the Northern Dipper bowl, as large as a wine cup, moved rapidly northeast to the Murky and vanished; its tail-track red-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiyou, a cup-sized star rose from the Northern Dipper bowl with a red-yellow tail-track, streaked northeast to the Murky and vanished.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，星出軍市，東南速行，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: a star rose from the Military Market, moved rapidly southeast to the Murky and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou, a star rose from the Military Market, streaked southeast to the Murky and vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年二月丁酉，星出太廟，色青白，西南入濁。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, day dingyou: a star rose from the Grand Temple, blue-white in color, entered the Murky southwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, second month, on dingyou, a blue-white star rose from the Grand Temple and entered the Murky southwest.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，星出中台，色赤黃，西北慢行，至內階沒。

translations.literal: Day yimao: a star rose from the Central Terrace, red-yellow in color, moved slowly northwest to the Inner Steps and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, a red-yellow star rose from the Central Terrace, moved slowly northwest to the Inner Steps and vanished.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，星出北斗魁，如杯，色青白，北行，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu: a star rose from the Northern Dipper bowl, like a cup, blue-white in color, traveled north to the Murky and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, a cup-sized blue-white star rose from the Northern Dipper bowl, traveled north to the Murky and vanished.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑晝，有星出中天，大如碗，西速行，至濁沒，尾跡赤黃。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou, by day: a star rose at mid-heaven, as large as a bowl, moved rapidly west to the Murky and vanished; its tail-track red-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jichou by day, a bowl-sized star rose at mid-heaven with a red-yellow tail-track, streaked west to the Murky and vanished.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，星出河鼓，大如盞，色赤黃，速行至天市垣宗內星沒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiwei: a star rose from the Drum at the River, as large as a wine cup, red-yellow, moved rapidly to the Clansman Inner Star of the Celestial Market Enclosure and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei, a cup-sized red-yellow star rose from the Drum at the River, streaked rapidly to the Clansman Inner Star of the Celestial Market Enclosure and vanished.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，星出危，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: a star rose from Rooftop, and vanished at the Murky.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, a star rose from Rooftop and vanished at the Murky.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，星出北斗魁，東北速行，至濁沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: a star rose from the Northern Dipper bowl, moved rapidly northeast to the Murky and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiyou, a star rose from the Northern Dipper bowl, streaked northeast to the Murky and vanished.

sentences.zh: 三年四月癸巳，星出房，至濁沒，明燭地，尾跡炸而散。

translations.literal: Third year, fourth month, day guisi: a star rose from the Room, and vanished at the Murky; its brilliance lit the ground; its tail-track exploded and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, fourth month, on guisi, a star rose from the Room and vanished at the Murky, its brilliance lighting the ground as its tail-track exploded and scattered.

sentences.zh: 七月庚申，晝漏未上，星出紫宮，西行，曳尾長二丈，沒，尾跡青白。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengshen: before the day watch had begun, a star rose from the Purple Palace, traveled west, dragging a tail two zhang long, and vanished; its tail-track blue-white.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengshen, before the day watch had begun, a star rose from the Purple Palace, traveled west dragging a tail two zhang long and vanished with a blue-white tail-track.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，有星出參，至天倉沒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: a star rose from the Three Stars, and vanished at the Celestial Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, a star rose from the Three Stars and vanished at the Celestial Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，星出王良，西北速行，至濁沒，尾跡青黃。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jimao: a star rose from Wang Liang, moved rapidly northwest to the Murky and vanished; its tail-track blue-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jimao, a star rose from Wang Liang with a blue-yellow tail-track, streaked northwest to the Murky and vanished.
